subject: Pilot credits and trial window for Atlas Literacy Project — dataset prep and annotation
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina@atlaslit.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Request: supplementary credits + trial extension for Atlas pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the onboarding session yesterday — it was helpful to see the token accounting and KV cache features. We kicked off a small preprocessing job overnight and already hit our initial trial cap. A few notes and asks: 

- Pilot scope: OCRed books (low-resource African languages) + crowdsourced annotations (~180k pages, ~450k segments).
- Current friction: our pipeline needs another 50k token-equivalent to finish the anonymization pass and a 30-day window extension so we can run the evaluation set through the reranker.
- Compliance: we can share a redacted sample and current IRB letter; we need to confirm where log retention will live for the pilot.

Would Redwood be able to grant a supplemental credit allocation (one-off) and extend the trial for an extra month? If helpful, Leo Park (copied) is our operations lead and can share the doc with dataset size breakdown.

Appreciate any help — this pilot is timeboxed for August and the extra runway would let us do a full quality check before a potential campus rollout.

Best,
Amina Yusuf
Executive Director, Atlas Literacy Project
Attachments: atlas_trial_dataset_sample.csv (CSV, 15 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina@atlaslit.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 18:27:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary credits + trial extension for Atlas pilot

Hi Amina — great to meet you yesterday as well.

Thanks for the sample and the clear ask. Short answers up front: we can usually do a one-off educational/nonprofit credit allocation and a 30-day extension; a few details to confirm first so we scope the right amount and satisfy our compliance checks.

Can you confirm:
- final estimated token-equivalent for the entire anonymization + rerank pass (rough number is fine)
- whether any of the data is PHI or otherwise regulated (IRB note is helpful)
- which KMS you prefer (AWS KMS, Google KMS, or customer-managed HSM) for pilot logs if you need retention outside Redwood?

Ben — can you weigh in on the promo code/credit bucket we can apply to Atlas? Tessa — can you confirm that a 30-day extension is ok from a CS/ops perspective and whether we need any additional SSO/accessing controls for their annotators?

If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute sync tomorrow morning to go through the breakdown.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Nonprofit Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina@atlaslit.org>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary credits + trial extension for Atlas pilot

Marissa / Amina — copying in my notes. We have two internal promo buckets that usually cover edu/nonprofit pilots: 1) 50k token credit + 30-day trial extension (standard), 2) 150k token credit + 60-day extension for larger scope (requires manager approval).

Given the numbers you quoted (~450k segments), my initial recommendation is to approve the standard 50k one-off and fast-track a second tranche if they show utilization patterns that justify the 150k option. I can provision the 50k immediately once Amina confirms no PHI and we get the redacted IRB.

I've attached the SOC2 summary we share with pilots (redacted) and a short education-promo pack so Amina has the formal terms.

Next steps:
- Amina: confirm PHI/regulatory status and share IRB redaction.
- Marissa/Tessa: confirm extension mechanics and whether their annotators need API keys or a shared workspace.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf (240 KB), edu-promo-30d-50k-credits.pdf (22 KB)
From: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina@atlaslit.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Leo Park <leo@edupartners.org>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 18:24:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary credits + trial extension for Atlas pilot

Hi all — quick update from our side. Leo and I reviewed the dataset: none of the pages contain direct PHI; we have an IRB waiver attached and have redacted named entities in the sample (see attached). Final rough estimate: anonymization + reranker pass will consume ~42k token-equivalent. That fits the 50k bucket.

We accept the 30-day extension and the standard promoter terms in the edu-promo PDF. If Redwood can provision the 50k credits and extend the trial window today, we’ll run the anonymization pipeline over the weekend and report back on Monday.

Thank you — truly appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Amina
Attachments: IRB_waiver_redacted.pdf (48 KB)
